source_law.text: A person, except a police officer in the performance of his or her duty, shall not drive a motorcycle or moped between moving or stationary vehicles occupying adjacent traffic lanes.

requirement_dispositions.evidence_or_gap: No accepted recording; original adjacent-lane and stationary-vehicle body evidence required.
Stationary and moving vehicle alternatives measured from separate original velocity/body sources; synthetic requests do not establish physical speed.

requirement_dispositions.branch: police officer in performance of duty exception
requirement_dispositions.evidence_or_gap: Police officer identity and performance of duty require separate independently reviewed sources; synthetic role cannot establish exception or legal outcome.
Motorcycle and moped alternatives require separate independently reviewed machine classification; NRS 482.0295, NRS 482.029 and autocycle applicability remain unavailable in frozen inputs.
